lines.zh: 我走得不快，南瓜头太沉了。
lines.en: I do not walk fast; the pumpkin head is heavy.

lines.zh: 十月末到十一月初，这几天我才出门。
lines.en: Late October to early November: only these days I go out.

lines.zh: 脚下一绊，我滚了半圈又站起来。
lines.en: I trip, roll halfway, then stand again.

lines.zh: 我跟在南瓜头爵士身后，慢慢挪。
lines.en: I shuffle behind Sir Pumpkinhead.

lines.zh: 每一步都踩得歪，像喝醉的稻草人。
lines.en: Each step lands crooked, like a drunk scarecrow.

lines.zh: 南瓜里的蜡烛晃，我的路也晃。
lines.en: The candle sways inside, and so does my path.

lines.zh: 落叶比我快，先到了田埂那头。
lines.en: The falling leaves reach the field edge first.

lines.zh: 我不赶时间，节日还没结束。
lines.en: I am in no hurry; the holiday is not over.

lines.zh: 鞋里塞着干草，走起来沙沙响。
lines.en: Dry straw in my shoes rustles as I walk.

lines.zh: 我绕开石头，免得脑袋再摔一次。
lines.en: I skirt the stones so my head does not fall again.

lines.zh: 田里没人，我就多走两圈。
lines.en: No one in the field, so I walk two extra laps.

lines.zh: 我慢慢跟上来，你别走太快。
lines.en: I am catching up slowly; do not walk so fast.

lines.zh: 我站着，蜡烛在里面轻轻烧。
lines.en: I stand still while the candle burns softly inside.

lines.zh: 南瓜子掉了一地，我懒得捡。
lines.en: Pumpkin seeds scatter; I cannot be bothered.

lines.zh: 风一吹，我的笑脸就歪了。
lines.en: The wind blows and my carved smile tilts.

lines.zh: 我在等十月二十五日过去。
lines.en: I wait for October twenty-fifth to pass.

lines.zh: 稻草从袖口钻出来，挠得我痒。
lines.en: Straw pokes from my cuff and tickles me.

lines.zh: 爵士没叫我，我就先站着。
lines.en: Sir Pumpkinhead has not called; I stand here.

lines.zh: 远处有人点灯，我数了三次。
lines.en: Someone lights a lamp; I count it three times.

lines.zh: 我比较弱，所以更懂得躲。
lines.en: I am weak, so I have learned to hide.

lines.zh: 南瓜壳里闷闷的，回声很好听。
lines.en: The pumpkin shell is stuffy and echoes nicely.

lines.zh: 田埂上的乌鸦看我一眼就走了。
lines.en: A crow glances at me and leaves.

lines.zh: 我试着跳一下，只离地半寸。
lines.en: I try to jump and rise half an inch.

lines.zh: 蜡烛快烧完了，我得省着点。
lines.en: The candle is low; I must make it last.

lines.zh: 我的影子比我还扁。
lines.en: My shadow is flatter than I am.

lines.zh: 没人来，我就跟稻草说说话。
lines.en: No one comes, so I talk to the straw.

lines.zh: 十月的风一过，我就该走了。
lines.en: Once the October wind passes, I'll have to go.

lines.zh: 壳里的火苗歪了一下，又直回来。
lines.en: The flame inside my shell leans, then straightens again.

lines.zh: 你盯着我的南瓜脸，我也盯着你。
lines.en: You stare at my pumpkin face; I stare back.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛是挖出来的两个洞。
lines.en: My eyes are two holes carved through.

lines.zh: 你手里没有糖，那我不笑了。
lines.en: No sweets in your hand, so I stop smiling.

lines.zh: 你挡住我的路，也挡住我的节日。
lines.en: You block my path and my holiday too.

lines.zh: 我歪头看你，里面的蜡烛也跟着歪。
lines.en: I tilt my head; the candle tilts with it.

lines.zh: 你身上有南瓜味吗？没有。
lines.en: Do you smell of pumpkin? No, you do not.

lines.zh: 我认得你的灯笼，去年也见过。
lines.en: I know your lantern; I saw it last year.

lines.zh: 别怕，我只是慢慢看。
lines.en: Do not fear; I am only looking.

lines.zh: 你笑我的脸，可你的脸也没好到哪去。
lines.en: You laugh at my face; yours is no better.

lines.zh: 我把脸转正，洞里的火晃了一下。
lines.en: I turn my face straight; the fire in it flickers.

lines.zh: 你退后，我的脖子就伸不长。
lines.en: Step back and my neck cannot stretch after you.

lines.zh: 我记住你了，十一月初之前都记得。
lines.en: I will remember you until early November.

lines.zh: 你把火把举高，我的洞就亮。
lines.en: Lift your torch; my holes light up.

lines.zh: 看什么看，没见过会走路的南瓜吗？
lines.en: What are you looking at, a walking pumpkin?

lines.zh: 南瓜裂了，蜡烛却没灭。
lines.en: The pumpkin cracks, but the candle stays lit.

lines.zh: 稻草掉了一地，我捡不回来。
lines.en: Straw scatters; I cannot gather it back.

lines.zh: 疼，但比起南瓜头爵士不算什么。
lines.en: It hurts, but nothing next to Sir Pumpkinhead's blows.

lines.zh: 我的头歪了，看什么都斜。
lines.en: My head is crooked; everything looks slanted.

lines.zh: 你打碎的是壳，不是我。
lines.en: You broke the shell, not me.

lines.zh: 我退两步，又被稻草绊住。
lines.en: I back two steps and trip on my own straw.

lines.zh: 蜡烛晃得厉害，我快站不稳。
lines.en: The candle sways hard; I can barely stand.

lines.zh: 我本来就弱，你也不用这么用力。
lines.en: I am weak already; you need not hit so hard.

lines.zh: 这一下让我想回土里待着。
lines.en: This blow makes me want to go back underground.

lines.zh: 壳上多了一个洞，光漏出来了。
lines.en: One more hole in the shell, and light leaks out.

lines.zh: 糖给我？那我考虑少走两步。
lines.en: Sweets for me? Then I may walk two steps less.

lines.zh: 南瓜派可以，但别放太多糖。
lines.en: Pumpkin pie is fine, but do not overdo the sugar.

lines.zh: 你举着胡萝卜，我又不是雪人。
lines.en: You hold a carrot; I am not a snowman.

lines.zh: 吃的收下，路还是照走。
lines.en: I take the food; the path stays the same.

lines.zh: 甜味飘进南瓜壳，蜡烛都亮了。
lines.en: The sweetness reaches my shell; the candle brightens.

lines.zh: 我慢，但我记得谁给过糖。
lines.en: I am slow, but I remember who gave sweets.

lines.zh: 你摇着南瓜，我差点就跟过去了。
lines.en: You wave a pumpkin; I almost follow.

lines.zh: 别用节日的东西勾我，我会当真。
lines.en: Do not tempt me with holiday things; I believe them.

lines.zh: 一小块就够，我胃口不大。
lines.en: A small piece is enough; my appetite is small.

lines.zh: 你给吃的，我就离爵士远一点。
lines.en: Feed me and I keep my distance from Sir.

lines.zh: 你撞得我滚了半圈，稻草撒出来。
lines.en: You knock me half a roll; straw spills out.

lines.zh: 轻点，我的南瓜壳会裂。
lines.en: Easy; my pumpkin shell may crack.

lines.zh: 我挡不住你，只能被推着走。
lines.en: I cannot stop you; I am only pushed along.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的脚，鞋里草都扁了。
lines.en: You step on my foot and flatten the straw.

lines.zh: 借过，我这把老骨头转得慢。
lines.en: Excuse me; these old bones turn slowly.

lines.zh: 撞一下就撞一下，我不记仇。
lines.en: One bump is one bump; I hold no grudge.

lines.zh: 我的头掉了，帮我扶一下？
lines.en: My head fell off; would you set it back?

lines.zh: 你从我身上穿过去，我就散架了。
lines.en: Walk through me and I come apart.

lines.zh: 别挤，蜡烛要倒了。
lines.en: Do not shove; the candle is tipping.

lines.zh: 我这么轻，你一推我就让开。
lines.en: I am so light; one push and I give way.

lines.zh: 节日里牵个手，也算作伴。
lines.en: Holding hands in the holiday counts as company.

lines.zh: 我这样慢，谁愿意等我就好。
lines.en: Slow as I am, anyone willing to wait will do.

lines.zh: 南瓜配南瓜，稻草配稻草。
lines.en: Pumpkin pairs with pumpkin, straw with straw.

lines.zh: 爵士说这事以后再说。
lines.en: Sir Pumpkinhead says we will discuss it later.

lines.zh: 蜡烛烧完之前，我大概等不到。
lines.en: Before the candle dies, I likely will not find one.

lines.zh: 我太弱了，护不住谁。
lines.en: I am too weak to protect anyone.

lines.zh: 要是有个伴，田埂就没那么长。
lines.en: With a companion, the field edge would feel shorter.

lines.zh: 十一月初一过，这事就黄了。
lines.en: Once November starts, this whole matter fades.

lines.zh: 我们的孩子会是小南瓜吗？
lines.en: Would our children be little pumpkins?

lines.zh: 你问这个，蜡烛都晃了。
lines.en: You ask that, and even my candle wavers.

lines.zh: 地上的南瓜子我捡，别的不碰。
lines.en: I pick up pumpkin seeds and nothing else.

lines.zh: 你掉的糖，我悄悄踢进草里。
lines.en: The sweet you dropped, I nudge into the grass.

lines.zh: 搬不动，我这胳膊是稻草。
lines.en: I cannot lift it; my arms are straw.

lines.zh: 捡起来又掉了，手不听使唤。
lines.en: I pick it up, drop it; my hands disobey.

lines.zh: 这块布正好补我的袖子。
lines.en: This cloth would patch my sleeve nicely.

lines.zh: 我捡了一根蜡烛头，还能点。
lines.en: I found a candle stub that still burns.

lines.zh: 东西太重，压得我往前栽。
lines.en: It is too heavy; it tips me forward.

lines.zh: 你别抢，那是我先看见的。
lines.en: Do not grab it; I saw it first.

lines.zh: 我只捡和节日有关的东西。
lines.en: I only pick up things tied to the holiday.

lines.zh: 扛在肩上走三步，掉了。
lines.en: I shoulder it for three steps, then drop it.

lines.zh: 爵士喊我了，你也该跑了。
lines.en: Sir Pumpkinhead called; you should run.

lines.zh: 我慢，可我认准了就不换。
lines.en: I am slow, but once fixed on you I do not switch.

lines.zh: 你踩坏了田里的南瓜，这账要算。
lines.en: You crushed the field pumpkins; that is a debt.

lines.zh: 我先绕到你后面，虽然要很久。
lines.en: I will circle behind you, though it takes a while.

lines.zh: 蜡烛烧旺了，说明我要动手。
lines.en: The candle flares; that means I am moving in.

lines.zh: 我打不过你，可我会一直跟着。
lines.en: I cannot beat you, but I will keep following.

lines.zh: 爵士在前，我在侧边。
lines.en: Sir takes the front; I take the side.

lines.zh: 你踩进南瓜地，就成了目标。
lines.en: Step into the pumpkin patch and you are a target.

lines.zh: 我举不起剑，只举得起南瓜。
lines.en: I cannot lift a sword, only a pumpkin.

lines.zh: 十一月初之前，你都在名单上。
lines.en: Until early November, you stay on the list.

lines.zh: 我慢慢挪过去，你别嫌我烦。
lines.en: I shuffle over slowly; do not find me tedious.

lines.zh: 这一季的仇，我记到明年。
lines.en: This season's grudge lasts me until next year.

lines.zh: 我离你还远，但我不会停。
lines.en: I am far, but I will not stop.

lines.zh: 稻草拖在地上，声音很响。
lines.en: Straw drags on the ground, loud and slow.

lines.zh: 你跑到田那头，我就走到田那头。
lines.en: You run to the field's end; I walk there too.

lines.zh: 我边走边掉南瓜子，你顺着找我就行。
lines.en: I drop seeds as I go; follow them to me.

lines.zh: 爵士在左边，我堵右边。
lines.en: Sir takes the left; I block the right.

lines.zh: 你回头看一眼，我就近了一步。
lines.en: You glance back, and I gain a step.

lines.zh: 我的蜡烛亮着，藏不住。
lines.en: My candle burns; I cannot hide.

lines.zh: 你躲进屋子，我就在门口等。
lines.en: Hide indoors; I will wait at the door.

lines.zh: 等我走到，你大概已经累了。
lines.en: By the time I arrive, you will be tired.

lines.zh: 这双脚不听使唤，但还是朝你走。
lines.en: These feet disobey, yet still head for you.

lines.zh: 南瓜滚下坡，我跟着滚。
lines.en: The pumpkin rolls downhill; I roll after it.

lines.zh: 你别跑太快，我头会掉。
lines.en: Do not run so fast; my head may fall.

lines.zh: 我慢得像节日结束前的最后一晚。
lines.en: I am as slow as the holiday's final night.

lines.zh: 我抡起南瓜，砸得不太准。
lines.en: I swing the pumpkin; it lands imprecisely.

lines.zh: 这一下很轻，你别介意。
lines.en: This blow is light; do not mind it.

lines.zh: 稻草手打人，像被扫帚扫过。
lines.en: A straw hand hits like a passing broom.

lines.zh: 我扑上去，自己先摔了。
lines.en: I lunge and trip over myself first.

lines.zh: 南瓜壳砸在你肩上，裂了。
lines.en: The pumpkin shell cracks on your shoulder.

lines.zh: 爵士吸引你，我从背后推一把。
lines.en: Sir draws you; I shove from behind.

lines.zh: 我很弱，所以专挑你的膝盖。
lines.en: I am weak, so I aim for your knees.

lines.zh: 蜡烛从洞里洒出来，烫到你。
lines.en: Candle wax spills from my holes onto you.

lines.zh: 打不动你，我就抱住你的腿。
lines.en: I cannot hurt you, so I cling to your leg.

lines.zh: 这一季挨的打，都还给你。
lines.en: Every blow this season, I return to you.

lines.zh: 十月二十五日，田里多了一个南瓜。
lines.en: On October twenty-fifth, one more pumpkin in the field.

lines.zh: 我从土里拱出来，头上还带着泥。
lines.en: I push out of the soil, mud still on my head.

lines.zh: 蜡烛自己亮了，我就醒了。
lines.en: The candle lights itself; I wake.

lines.zh: 十一月初我就走，别留我。
lines.en: I leave in early November; do not keep me.

lines.zh: 稻草塞得太满，我走起来晃。
lines.en: The straw is packed too full; I wobble.

lines.zh: 节日的味道飘过来，我跟着就来了。
lines.en: The smell of the holiday drifts by, and I follow.

lines.zh: 我比田里那些南瓜矮一点。
lines.en: I am a little shorter than the field pumpkins.

lines.zh: 头一次睁眼，看见的是月亮。
lines.en: The first thing I see is the moon.

lines.zh: 爵士还没来，我先站在田埂上。
lines.en: Sir has not come; I stand at the field edge.

lines.zh: 我的脸是昨天刻好的。
lines.en: My face was carved yesterday.

lines.zh: 十月末的风一吹，我就有了形状。
lines.en: Late October wind blows, and I take shape.

lines.zh: 南瓜壳扣在头上，有点闷。
lines.en: The pumpkin shell on my head is stuffy.

lines.zh: 我从藤蔓底下钻出来，藤还缠着脚。
lines.en: I crawl from under the vines, still tangled.

lines.zh: 这一夜开始，我只会慢吞吞地走。
lines.en: From tonight on, I only walk slowly.

lines.zh: 我的壳是干的，别拿火靠近。
lines.en: My shell is dry; keep fire away.

lines.zh: 摔下去时，南瓜先着地。
lines.en: Falling, my pumpkin lands first.

lines.zh: 水进南瓜壳，蜡烛灭了。
lines.en: Water fills the shell and the candle dies.

lines.zh: 炸得稻草满天，像过节的彩纸。
lines.en: The blast scatters straw like holiday confetti.

lines.zh: 箭插在南瓜上，像一根蜡烛。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my pumpkin like a candle.

lines.zh: 咒语打进来，蜡烛变成了蓝色。
lines.en: A curse hits and my candle turns blue.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，只烧蜡烛。
lines.en: I eat nothing; I only burn the candle.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我的壳焦了一块。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and chars a patch of my shell.

lines.zh: 掉下去的时候，蜡烛还亮着。
lines.en: As I fall, the candle is still lit.
